lines.text: Three days after arriving, Festus went up from Caesarea to Jerusalem, where leaders asked him to summon Paul.
Festus said some leaders could come down with him to Caesarea and accuse Paul there.
After no more than forty days, Festus went down to Caesarea, where the Jews brought many charges against Paul.

wrong_details.true: no more than eight or ten days

lines.text: Paul said he had committed no offense, and he said he ought to be tried at Caesar's judgment seat.
Paul appealed to Caesar, and Festus conferred with the Sanhedrin and said he would go to Caesar.
